verses.pali: “Ekapuggalassa, bhikkhave, kālakiriyā bahuno janassa anutappā hoti.
verses.english: “The death of one individual, mendicants, is regretted by many people.
The Realized One, the perfected one, the fully awakened Buddha.

verses.pali: Imassa kho, bhikkhave, ekapuggalassa kālakiriyā bahuno janassa anutappā hotī”ti.
verses.english: This is the one individual, mendicants, whose death is regretted by many people.”
